ar-clean-arch.summary: PricingService imports only domain-owned types. No infrastructure imports, no cross-layer boundary crossings.

issues.message: Layer boundary violation: domain layer imports ORM entity from infrastructure layer (src/domain/pricing/PricingService.ts line 14: import InvoiceEntity from infrastructure/orm).
Layer boundary violation: domain layer imports concrete TypeORM repository instead of domain-owned port (line 18: import TypeOrmInvoiceRepository from infrastructure/orm).

ar-layer-violation.summary: Two layer boundary violations: domain imports infrastructure ORM entity and concrete repository, violating inward dependency rule.
